name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.23.0 (released 2026-05-18, https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases/tag/v2.23.0) is the latest release, adding per-visitor topic creation rate limits to mitigate topic enumeration/squatting attacks and fixing a same-origin script execution vulnerability (GHSA-j8hr-p342-xrmh) in the web app's publish dialog. Recent releases (v2.19–v2.22) have focused on self-hosting scalability improvements including S3-compatible attachment storage, PostgreSQL read replica support, and several security fixes (SSRF via web push endpoint, GHSA-w9hq-5jg7-q4j7). Email notification now requires address verification via smtp-sender-verify due to abuse on ntfy.sh causing AWS SES suspension.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL-2.0 (client); check repository for exact dual-license details
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026, most recently v2.23.0 on 2026-05-18
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — access tokens, user accounts, per-topic ACLs, and rate limiting are supported
answers.Is there a hosted cloud version availabl: Yes — ntfy.sh is the official hosted instance

breaking_excerpts: v2.20.0: ntfy takes full control of attachment-cache-dir/S3 bucket — files matching message ID format (^[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$) with no DB entries will be deleted on startup. Do not share this directory with other applications.
v2.21.0: smtp-sender-verify flag introduced; ntfy.sh now requires verified email addresses before sending email notifications due to AWS SES account suspension from abuse.
v2.23.0: stacktrace-js, stacktrace-gps, humanize-duration, and js-base64 removed from the web app dependency tree.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a powerful multi-platform notification library supporting 80+ services but is a library/CLI tool rather than a standalone server with a pub-sub model like ntfy.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing but is a proprietary cloud service with usage limits and no self-hosting capability unlike ntfy.

alternatives.name: Ntopng Alerts / Alertmanager
alternatives.review: Alertmanager excels at routing and deduplicating alerts from Prometheus but is focused on infrastructure monitoring workflows rather than general-purpose lightweight push notifications like ntfy.
